name: Japanese flowering cherry
intro: Flowering cherries include many species and cultivars. This card uses Prunus serrulata as a representative.
observe: Look for alternate, toothed leaves and horizontal marks on the bark. Flower form varies by cultivar.
habitat: Grows in sun or partial shade. Real trees shed leaves and flower seasonally, not all year.
fact: The pink canopy is a game shorthand. Not every flowering cherry has double pink flowers.
